{{Quote|In retaliation, Commodore Daymont 'Veracity' Praji bombed Zarracina III into radioactive winter. The Republic annexed the system and the few surviving Zarracines became a nomadic species.|Dr. Gabrel Treon, "Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji: A Cartel of Genes"|<ref name="Tinker" />}}
A [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the '''Zarracines''' [[Homeworld/Legends|hailed]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zarracina III]]. In [[11,660 BBY]], the [[Pius Dea]]&ndash;controlled [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] attempted to gain control of the planet, with the Zarracines resisting the efforts. Ultimately, Republic [[Commodore/Legends|Commodore]] [[Daymont Praji]] ordered the [[Bombardment of Zarracina III|orbital bombardment]] of the world that [[Speciecide|rendered]] the species nearly extinct. The surviving Zarracines became nomads in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] and harbored a [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]]-long hatred for the Republic and [[House Praji/Legends|House Praji]]. Many Zarracines later joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], and, during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], five Zarracine [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorists]] unsuccessfully attempted to board the [[Limousine/Legends|repulsorlimo]] of [[First Minister (Coruscant Ministry of Ingress)/Legends|First Minister]] [[Tannon Praji/Legends|Tannon Praji]] of the [[Coruscant Ministry of Ingress/Legends|Coruscant Ministry of Ingress]].

==Society and culture==
{{Quote|Harboring much hatred for the destroyers of their world, they kept to themselves, although many joined the Confederacy of Independent Systems and later Nolaa Tarkona's Diversity Alliance.|Dr. Gabrel Treon, "Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji: A Cartel of Genes"|<ref name="Tinker" />}}
The Zarracines were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zarracina III]]<ref name="Tinker" /> in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Zarracina sector/Legends|Zarracina sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Zarracina system/Legends|Zarracina system]]</ref> They were originally governed by a [[Zarracina III ruling council|ruling council]]. After the [[Bombardment of Zarracina III|devastation]] of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] by the [[Republic Military/Legends|forces]] of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Commodore/Legends|Commodore]] [[Daymont Praji]], the Zarracines became a relatively isolationist nomadic species. Members of the species, however, maintained a hatred for both the Republic and [[House Praji/Legends|House Praji]] for more than ten [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]].<ref name="Tinker" />

==History==
{{Quote|But long before the end, in 11,660 BBY, a stable hyperspace jump point was discovered in the Zarracina system, and acquiring its inhabited third planet became a priority for the Republic. The Zarracines refused to accommodate Coruscant's envoys and on the verge of capture the entire ruling council killed themselves to avoid conversion and spite their conquerors.|Dr. Gabrel Treon, "Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji: A Cartel of Genes"|<ref name="Tinker" />}}
[[File:Twelfth_Pius_Dea_Crusade.jpg|thumb|left|295px|The Galactic Republic targeted the Zarracines in a crusade.]]
In [[11,660 BBY]], a stable [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Hyperspace jump point/Legends|jump point]] was discovered in the [[Zarracina system/Legends|Zarracina system]]. Due to the discovery's strategic nature, acquiring Zarracina III became a priority for the Galactic Republic, which at the [[Time/Legends|time]] was under the control of the [[Humanocentrism|Humanocentrist]] [[Pius Dea]] cult. The Zarracines, however, rejected [[Envoy/Legends|envoys]] from<ref name="Tinker" /> the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The Republic then initiated a [[Twelfth Pius Dea Crusade|crusade]] targeting both that species and the [[Teirasan]]s of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Teirasa system/Legends|Teirasa system]].<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

On the verge of capture by the Republic, Zarracina III's entire ruling council [[Death/Legends|died]] by suicide in order to avoid conversion to the Pius Dea religion and to spite the would-be Republic conquerors. In response, Republic Commodore Praji ordered the [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] of the planet, which sent it into a state of [[Radiation/Legends|radioactive]] [[Winter/Legends|winter]]. That act caused the [[Speciecide|near-extinction]] of the Zarracines.<ref name="Tinker" />

==Zarracines in the galaxy==
{{Quote|''[Ottegru Grey]'' proved his worth before the first month was out: foiling CIS-backed Zarracine terrorists who tried to board the Minister's repulsorlimo in a harrowing chase and aerial fisticuffs.|Dr. Gabrel Treon, "Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji: A Cartel of Genes"|<ref name="Tinker" />}}
[[File:TannonPraji.jpg|thumb|right|245px|Zarracine terrorists once attempted to board the repulsorlimo of Tannon Praji.]]
The Republic subsequently annexed the Zarracina [[Star system/Legends|system]] while what few Zarracines survived adopted nomadic existence in [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. Many members of the species later joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="Tinker" /> which was [[Raxus Address/Legends|formed]] in [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]]<ref name="EGTW" /> and fought against the Republic in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]&ndash;[[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

At one point during that conflict, five Confederacy-backed Zarracine [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorists]] chased the [[Limousine/Legends|repulsorlimo]] of [[First Minister (Coruscant Ministry of Ingress)/Legends|First Minister]] [[Tannon Praji/Legends|Tannon Praji]] of the [[Coruscant Ministry of Ingress/Legends|Coruscant Ministry of Ingress]] in an attempt to board it. As a result of the ensuing [[Atmosphere/Legends|aerial]] [[Unarmed combat/Legends|fistfight]] between the terrorists and Praji's [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] [[Ottegru Grey]], three of the attackers fell to their deaths, while the other two were delivered by Grey into Republic custody.<ref name="Tinker" />

Numerous Zarracines also joined the [[Diversity Alliance]],<ref name="Tinker" /> an [[Anti-Humanism|anti-Human]] extremist movement active by [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" /> In [[104 ABY]], [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Gabrel Treon]] mentioned the history of the Zarracines in the article "[[Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji: A Cartel of Genes]]," published in the [[Byblos Journal of Historical Science]].<ref name="Tinker" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Zarracines were first mentioned in "[[Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji]]," an article authored by [[Nathan O'Keefe]] and published as part of the [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] feature on [[February 5]], [[2009]].<ref name="Tinker" />
